title: Create images at the size you need
summary: New Image now creates custom-sized white, colored or transparent canvases, with validation and protection for the document already open.

Added: New Image through Ctrl+N, File > New, or Create: enter pixel dimensions, choose an RGBA canvas color or use a transparent background.
A checkerboard preview makes transparent canvas areas visible without adding pixels to saved projects or PNG exports.
CLI new --background RRGGBBAA uses the same document constructor as the desktop editor.
Improved: Invalid dimensions disable Create; image size and allocation limits apply before a canvas is created.
Cancel leaves the current document intact. Creating a replacement checks unsaved changes, and Save and continue saves the original first.
New canvases start unsaved. Transparent and partially transparent colors survive project save/reopen and PNG export exactly.
Target-label tooltips now explain the feature scope, including partially implemented areas.

limitations: The New Image workflow is implemented and locally verified; exact reference color-picker appearance/defaults and invalid-input comparison remain unverified. Its full mapped scope therefore retains a red target label.
Full interface parity, detailed properties, capture, clipboard, hotkeys, callouts, effects, history and video remain in progress or planned.
Native Windows snap layouts and dragging a maximized window to restore it are not included. Use Restore or double-click the title.
Canvas creation is limited to 25 megapixels and 32,768 pixels per side. Text uses a dialog and basic left-to-right layout.
Windows x64 portable alpha; not code-signed. Editable projects retain original pixels; share flattened PNGs when redacting content.
